body:
New GET /api/v1/sip-accounts/me/webphone-credentials (bearer-authenticated) returns the caller's own extension+password for whichever web phone identity is actually theirs. New WEBPHONE_SECRETS_JSON env var (mirrors SIP_SECRETS_JSON). Console's Web Phone card only shows when this succeeds. New sudo-queue/72-provision-web-extension.sh generalizes provisioning a real <extension>web endpoint to any extension. Verified end to end with a throwaway test account (200 OK, correct extension+password), cleaned up after. Rebuilt and restarted idunapro myself (no sudo needed for go build/systemctl --user). Commits IDUNA_PRO 12facae, CarePyre 56ac6c4, MONOREPO (sudo-queue/72).

⚓ ☃
title: Web Phone now per-user (not hardcoded to 1000) and gated on a real provisioned webphone identity
